formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p12_t1_nearest_add_error_le_right (representable : Real -> Prop) (x y s : Real) (hx : representable x) (hs : p12Nearest representable (x+y) s) : abs (s-(x+y)) <= abs y
formal_statement.plain_language: A nearest representable approximation to x+y has absolute error no larger than the right summand whenever x itself is representable.

informal_proof: Use x as a representable competitor in the nearest-rounding relation and simplify the competitor distance to |y|.
